findings.title: CSP unsafe-inline for scripts
findings.description: 'unsafe-inline' in scriptSrc weakens XSS protection. Mapbox GL JS requires this because it generates inline event handlers. Mitigation: DOMPurify sanitization is applied at render time, which catches XSS payloads before they reach the DOM. This is defense in depth, not a gap, but document that CSP is not the primary XSS barrier here.

findings.title: Production CORS not configured
findings.description: .env does not contain ALLOWED_ORIGINS for production domain. The server will fall back to localhost, which will break CORS when deployed. Add ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://clima.palayan.gov.ph to .env before production deployment.

findings.title: Console.log password in dev mode
findings.description: server.js line 120 logs generated passwords with console.log. This is gated by process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production', which is correct, but the check won't fire if NODE_ENV is unset (undefined !== 'production' is true). Set NODE_ENV=production in production .env or remove the log entirely.
